system.description:
Favoured weapon: Morningstar

Granted power: Once/day: enter a willing creature's dream during a long rest and communicate freely within it. Advantage on Insight checks. Once per encounter, a creature you hit with your morningstar makes a Will save or cannot take reactions until the end of its next turn.
